text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide has rebuilt her winning equation from the ground up in preparation for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During that process, she has gained a newfound intensity. Even Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket can't help but notice the difference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The BNW showdown is about to take place in the final Classic race, and sparks are sure to fly!
